name: Three Reasons
description: A counted list, delivered fast: one person, three numbered reasons, five seconds each, with the number burned into every caption. The count is the retention device — a viewer who has seen "1" will wait for "3" — so this is the format for a brand with several small proofs rather than one big one.

claim.description: What the three reasons are reasons for, e.g. 'why we stopped using spreadsheets'.

reasons.description: Exactly 3 reasons, as a list of short strings. Each must be a fact, not an adjective.

cta.description: Closing spoken call to action, said over the third reason.

presenter.description: Casting note, e.g. 'man, 30s, agency owner, headphones round neck'.

value.frame: Shot on an iPhone front-facing camera, handheld selfie angle, vertical 9:16, photorealistic. Realistic skin texture with visible pores, faint freckles, natural sheen, no beauty filter. Daylight from one side plus ordinary room light, uneven shadows. Casual clothes with real creases. A working desk or counter behind them with specific everyday clutter. Slightly off-centre framing, mild phone-lens distortion, subtle grain. Both eyes open, direct eye contact with the lens, mouth slightly parted mid-sentence.
value.motion: Keep the exact same person, hair, wardrobe and room as the reference image. Handheld phone feel with slight drift. Quick, energetic delivery: the person counts on their fingers or taps the air to mark each point. Natural blinking and breathing. Continuous phone footage, no cuts.
value.negative: eyes closed, mid-blink, looking away, head turned away, profile view, studio lighting, cinematic colour grade, airbrushed skin, plastic skin, beauty filter, CGI, 3D render, stock photo, model headshot, polished commercial look, watermark, text overlay, subtitles, extra fingers, warped hands

nodes.system: You write and direct fast counted-list video for vertical feeds. Every item is concrete and falsifiable. You cut every word that is not carrying weight, because five seconds is five seconds.

schema.actor: one paragraph pinning down age, build, hair, face, exact clothing and the specific room
schema.master_frame_prompt: still-image prompt for the opening frame

shots.frame_prompt: edit instruction from the master frame
shots.motion_prompt: delivery and gesture, with the spoken line in quotes

nodes.prompt:
{{shot.frame_prompt}}

Preserve the person's identity, facial structure, hair, wardrobe, room and lighting from the reference image exactly. Change only expression, hand position and framing. Keep the eyes open and on the lens.
